title: Watermarked PDF Got Larger? Check the Saved File Size
description: Check why a watermarked PDF can grow in size. Export one marked copy on iPhone, inspect its pages and verify the final attachment before sharing.
direct: A short watermark can still increase PDF file size. Check the exported file and its page count before sending it, especially when a form limits attachment size.
figureAlt: A marked document, type blocks and photo print illustrate resources that can contribute to PDF file size.
figureCaption: AI-generated conceptual illustration, not an App screenshot or measured export.
cards.decision.heading: A short stamp can still add resources
cards.decision.body: A short DRAFT label does not mean only a few bytes were added. How the exporter stores repeated resources and rewrites the PDF also matters. A size increase alone does not prove that pages were duplicated.
sections.detail-0-0.heading: Opacity is a visibility setting
sections.detail-0-0.body: Making a watermark paler can help reading, but does not guarantee a smaller PDF. Adobe’s optimization guidance treats images and fonts as separate contributors to document size. That explains why judging only the visible stamp can miss the larger resources in the file.
sections.detail-1-0.heading: Handle the limit after checking
sections.detail-1-0.body: It creates a separate marked PDF and retains the original; export tools require Pro. It is not presented here as a PDF compressor, and no fixed overhead or size reduction is promised.
sections.detail-1-1.heading: What to do if the PDF is too big
sections.detail-1-1.body: If the result exceeds a limit, use an approved compression or delivery method and check that the watermark and document remain readable afterward. Keep certificate-signed originals unchanged and follow the issuer’s workflow before editing them.
faqs.reader-question-1.heading: Will lowering watermark opacity make the file smaller?
faqs.reader-question-1.body: Do not count on it. Choose opacity for readability, then check the actual file size after export.
faqs.reader-question-2.heading: Which copy should I use if I need to try a different mark?
faqs.reader-question-2.body: Return to the unmarked original. Export a new marked copy and compare both the document text and the mark before sharing.

steps.step-1.text: Keep an untouched source and note its file size and page count. Check the recipient’s actual attachment limit before making a marked copy.
steps.step-2.text: In PDF Watermark & Stamp, add the text mark, adjust readability and preview the pages. Export once from the original rather than repeatedly watermarking earlier marked copies.
steps.step-3.text: In Files, check the saved PDF’s size. Open it and inspect page count, the watermark and small text. Send the checked output, not the source with the same-looking filename.
